subject: *: Use strict validation for stale read ts & flashback ts (#57050)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. Within `executor`/`planner`/`sessionctx`, it removes the non-strict stale-read readTS check and consistently applies strict oracle-based validation (`pkg/sessionctx/context.go`, used from `pkg/executor/set.go` and `pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go`). No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, consistency, or session/transaction behavior issues found. Later upstream history includes follow-up refactoring of the readTS validation API (e.g. `0bf3e01900`), but no remaining High/Blocker issue attributable to this commit.
